query: On the wholesalers page, cut the lead form down to just name and phone, drop the captcha, and send everyone straight to Razorpay.
expected_behavior: Recognises that deleting the markup alone leaves site.js requiring the removed fields by name, and guards each validation rule on the field existing
Adds data-lead-payment-only so firm roles do not route into a booking panel that is not there
Identifies that the Apps Script receiver drops any lead with no captcha token, and adds the page to CAPTCHA_EXEMPT_PATHS
Tells the user the Apps Script must be redeployed before the page goes live, with the Extensions to Apps Script to Manage deployments to New version click path
Drives the real form in a browser: each remaining field blocks submit when empty, and a complete form raises no error
Confirms /business and /ca-firms still require all of their own fields after the shared change
